title: MNN-Pocket-0.3B Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.12311v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This technical report presents MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a compact 300M-parameter dense language model designed for efficient on-device deployment and supporting context lengths of up to 32K tokens. With an INT4 deployment footprint of only 173 MB and decoding throughput of up to 466 tokens/s on iPad Pro M5 (Metal), it can be seamlessly integrated into applications on edge devices such as smartphones and smart glasses. MNN-Pocket-0.3B is developed through the co-design of its architecture, data, training pipeline, and inference system. Hardware-aware architecture selection and dependency-aware vocabulary pruning balance model capability with on-device memory and compute constraints. A four-stage pre-training pipeline covering approximately 4.1 trillion high-quality Chinese and English tokens equips the model with broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. translated_abstract: 本技术报告介绍了 MNN-Pocket-0.3B，这是一个紧凑的 3 亿参数稠密语言模型，专为高效的端侧部署而设计，支持最长 32K token 的上下文长度。其 INT4 部署体积仅 173 MB，在 iPad Pro M5（Metal）上的解码吞吐量高达每秒 466 个 token，可无缝集成到智能手机、智能眼镜等边缘设备的应用中。MNN-Pocket-0.3B 通过架构、数据、训练流程和推理系统的协同设计开发而成。硬件感知的架构选择和依赖感知的词表剪枝在模型能力与端侧内存及计算约束之间取得了平衡。一个覆盖约 4.1 万亿高质量中英文 token 的四阶段预训练流程赋予模型广泛的知识和推理能力。随后是一个包含指令微调等内容的三阶段后训练流程（原文此处截断）。
tldr: MNN-Pocket-0.3B 是一个面向端侧部署的 3 亿参数紧凑语言模型，通过架构、数据、训练流程和推理系统的协同设计，实现了仅 173 MB 的 INT4 体积、最高 466 tokens/s 的解码速度和 32K 上下文支持。
en_tdlr: MNN-Pocket-0.3B is a compact 300M-parameter language model co-designed across architecture, data, training pipeline, and inference system, achieving efficient on-device deployment with a 173 MB INT4 footprint, up to 466 tokens/s decoding speed, and 32K context support.
